== Description ==

Printed deck sheet (Dark Side) from [[2008 Texas Match Play Championship]] Day 2, attributed to [[Joe Olson]]: [[2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 Joe Olson DS Bring Him Before Me]]. The sheet's Player Name box is blank; the footer gives the file name <code>joeds_day2.html</code> and the print date 4/29/2008. The attribution is uncertain {{Mystery|question=Did Joe Olson play this deck at the 2008 Texas Match Play Championship|section=2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 sheets|nocat=yes}}.

== Source and credit ==

Page 3 of the Players Committee's decklist PDF [[:File:2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]] ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/TMM/Final/2008+Texas+MPC+Day+2.pdf 2008 Texas MPC Day 2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014173104/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/TMM/Final/2008+Texas+MPC+Day+2.pdf Internet Archive]).

== Changes ==

Page 3 of the PDF rendered to PNG at 130 dpi (1105 × 1430 pixels) with pdftoppm; no other changes.
